snippet.title: Turning Manor Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Turning Manor on Steam now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3855530?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=reveal&utm_medium=social

Turning Manor is a first person spot the difference horror puzzle game. The job is simple: count the differences and choose an exit. Yet it wont be so easy... Explore and uncover the secrets of Turning Manor.

Developer Note:
No part of this game knowingly uses AI generated content or images. Though many industry standard programs incorporate AI into their workflow and we can’t guarantee externally created assets are not AI generated, Sabbatical Games tries to minimize the impact on our final content by using a combination of hand crafted, photo scanned and creative commons assets.

"Welcome to HorrorLand" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
